description: UtilMisc.java is a utility class in the Apache OfBiz framework providing miscellaneous static helper functions for collections, type conversions, locale parsing, file operations, and other common utilities used across the project.

classes.name: UtilMisc
classes.description: Utility class providing static helper methods for collections, type conversions, locale parsing, file operations, etc.

methods.name: initCause
methods.description: Sets the cause of a Throwable to another Throwable.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compare two Comparable objects or two Lists for equality.

methods.name: toIterator
methods.description: Convert a collection to an iterator, or return null if collection is null.

methods.name: toMap
methods.description: Create a Map from key-value pairs or a single map.

methods.name: printMap
methods.description: Generate a string representation of a map with entries formatted as 'key --> value'.

methods.name: makeListWritable
methods.description: Create a modifiable LinkedList from a Collection.

methods.name: makeMapWritable
methods.description: Create a modifiable HashMap from a Map.

methods.name: makeMapSerializable
methods.description: Remove non-Serializable entries from a Map.

methods.name: makeArrayListSerializable
methods.description: Remove non-Serializable entries from an ArrayList.

methods.name: sortMaps
methods.description: Sort a list of Maps by specified keys.

methods.name: getMapFromMap
methods.description: Retrieve a nested Map from a Map, creating it if not exists.

methods.name: getListFromMap
methods.description: Retrieve a nested List from a Map, creating it if not exists.

methods.name: addToBigDecimalInMap
methods.description: Add a BigDecimal value to a map entry, initializing if absent.

methods.name: removeFirst
methods.description: Remove and return the first element from a List.

methods.name: collectionToSet
methods.description: Convert a collection to a Set, removing nulls.

methods.name: collectionToString
methods.description: Concatenate collection elements into a String separated by delimiter.

methods.name: toSet
methods.description: Create a Set from varargs or collection.

methods.name: toList
methods.description: Create a List from varargs.

methods.name: addToListInMap
methods.description: Add an element to a list within a map, creating the list if necessary.

methods.name: addToSetInMap
methods.description: Add an element to a set within a map, creating the set if necessary.

methods.name: addToSortedSetInMap
methods.description: Add an element to a sorted set within a map, creating the set if necessary.

methods.name: toDouble
methods.description: Convert an object to a double primitive, defaulting to 0.0.

methods.name: toDoubleObject
methods.description: Convert an object to a Double, or null if not possible.

methods.name: toInteger
methods.description: Convert an object to an int, defaulting to 0.

methods.name: toIntegerObject
methods.description: Convert an object to an Integer, or null if not possible.

methods.name: toLong
methods.description: Convert an object to a long, defaulting to 0.

methods.name: toLongObject
methods.description: Convert an object to a Long, or null if not possible.

methods.name: parseLocale
methods.description: Parse a locale string into a Locale object.

methods.name: ensureLocale
methods.description: Ensure an object is a Locale, parsing string if needed, or default.

methods.name: availableLocales
methods.description: Return a list of available locales sorted by display name.

methods.name: getHostHeadersAllowed
methods.description: Retrieve list of allowed host headers for security.

methods.name: staticWait
methods.description: Deprecated method that calls Thread.sleep().

methods.name: copyFile
methods.description: Copy contents from source file to target file.

methods.name: getViewLastIndex
methods.description: Calculate last index for paginated views.

methods.name: splitPhoneNumber
methods.description: Parse a phone number string into components using Google's libphonenumber library.
